# Core Rule 10 - Losing is part of the game/The game doesn’t revolve around you
Your character will frequently die, sometimes without even a possibility of avoiding it and often for no reason. Events will often be out of your control. No matter how good or prepared Sometimes you just lose. Keep this in mind as you play, and remember to take breaks especially if you’re on a death loop.
Any malding or extreme toxicity over this can and will be actioned by admins at their discretion.
Goob has multiple antags that convert or force you into a role you did not pick or may not really wanna play. While we would never force you to play when you didn’t want to. Continued examples of /suicide or /ghosting when something happens to you could be considered bad acting and thus punished as this can often lead to balance issues or just wasted effort for other players.
